entities.name: Heartstone
entities.description: Object a Phyrexian newt receives when created; glows while it lives, turns black at death, and gives sentience.

entities.name: Phyrexian newt
entities.description: Phyrexian creature given sentience by a heartstone.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Phyrexian whose heartstone was used by Urza to give sentience to Karn after her sacrifice.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Used Xantcha's heartstone to give Karn sentience.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem given sentience by Xantcha's heartstone.

events.summary: After Xantcha's sacrifice, Urza used her blackened heartstone to give sentience to the silver golem Karn.
events.quote: After her sacrifice, Xantcha 's heartstone was used by Urza to give sentience to the silver golem Karn .

relations.note: Gave Karn sentience with the heartstone.
relations.quote: used by Urza to give sentience to the silver golem Karn
